techStack.database: Supabase (PostgreSQL) with local persistent mock fallback (mock_db.json via mock-db.ts)
techStack.caching_rate_limiting: Upstash Redis with in-memory map fallback

databaseSchema.description: Unified database layer. If SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY environment variables are missing or default, it falls back to a local JSON file (mock_db.json) in the project root.

quizzes.description: Stores the 10 quiz barrels corresponding to the 10 heritage sites.

columns.quiz_id: UUID (Foreign Key -> quizzes.id, ON DELETE CASCADE)
columns.question: TEXT (Not Null)
columns.correct_answer: CHAR(1) (Not Null, CHECK A, B, C, D)

questions.description: Stores the pool of questions (20 per quiz/barrel).

columns.participant_id: UUID (Foreign Key -> participants.id, ON DELETE CASCADE)
columns.quiz_id: UUID (Foreign Key -> quizzes.id, ON DELETE CASCADE)

quiz_attempts.description: Logs individual quiz attempt events, scoring, and duration.

columns.participant_id: UUID (Primary Key, Foreign Key -> participants.id, ON DELETE CASCADE)
columns.current_attempt_id: UUID (Foreign Key -> quiz_attempts.id, ON DELETE SET NULL)

participant_progress.description: Maintains accumulated state (score, total time, next target barrel) for participants.

columns.participant_id: UUID (Foreign Key -> participants.id, Nullable, ON DELETE SET NULL)

audit_logs.description: Logs critical user actions (registration, scan attempts, wrong scans, submissions) for audit trail.

src/lib/db.ts.purpose: Primary database adapter. Instantiates Supabase if environment variables are set, otherwise instantiates MockDB fallback.

src/lib/mock-db.ts.purpose: Local fallback database. Persists database state to `mock_db.json` in the root folder using Node fs sync APIs. Contains memory fallback for serverless read-only contexts.

src/lib/questions-data.ts.purpose: Static repository containing metadata and 200 questions (20 per barrel) for all 10 heritage sites.

src/lib/jwt.ts.purpose: Creates and decodes participant session JWTs using the jose library.

src/lib/rate-limit.ts.purpose: Limits route spam using Upstash Redis. Falls back to local in-memory Map structure if Redis is unconfigured or fails.

src/lib/admin-auth.ts.purpose: Authenticates administrative requests by comparing request headers (`x-admin-password`) or cookies (`admin_session`) to a predefined ADMIN_PASSWORD.

api/auth/register.behavior: Creates a participant, instantiates progress record with a random starting next_barrel_id (1-10), generates JWT cookie `participant_session`, and records an audit log.

GET.behavior: Verifies session token, checks if participant account is suspended, fetches and returns their current progress.

DELETE.behavior: Logs out participant by clearing the `participant_session` cookie.

api/barrel/[barrelId].behavior: Processes QR code scanning. Verifies that the scanned barrelId matches the participant's assigned `next_barrel_id`. If correct, creates/resumes a quiz attempt, selects 5 random questions from the quiz's 20-question pool, shuffles the options, strips the correct answers, logs an audit record, and returns the questions. If incorrect, audits the wrong scan and returns a 400 error indicating the correct barrel.

responses.200: Quiz title, description, questions (without answers), and attempt details
responses.400: Invalid barrel ID OR wrong barrel scanned (returns assigned_barrel ID)

payload.answers: array of { questionId: string, answer: string } (required)

api/quiz/submit.behavior: Scores the submitted answers server-side (10 points per correct answer, max 50). Calculates elapsed time on the server to prevent cheating. Updates participant progress (increments completed count, adds score and time). Selects a new random unattempted barrel ID for the next destination (or null if all 10 completed). Resets current_attempt_id, audits the submission, and returns results.

responses.200: Score, correct count, time taken, updated progress details
responses.400: Validation error, wrong active attempt, or duplicate submission

api/leaderboard.behavior: Returns leaderboard rankings. Overall: sorted by total score descending, then total time ascending. Quiz-specific: sorted by attempt score descending, then attempt time ascending.

responses.200: Leaderboard list with rank, name, college, score, and time taken

api/admin/stats.behavior: Retrieves high-level stats: total active/disabled participants, overall averages, completion distributions, and average performance scores/times for each of the 10 barrels.

GET.behavior: Lists all registered participants enriched with their current progress statistics.

POST.behavior: Suspends or unsuspends a participant account, logs an audit trace.

DELETE.behavior: Deletes participant from the database, cascades to clear progress and attempts, logs an audit trace.

api/admin/audit-logs.behavior: Fetches audit log entries sorted by creation timestamp descending.

responses.200: List of audit logs with action details, IPs, and user agents

api/admin/export-csv.behavior: Exports all participant registration, progress, status, and rank details to an Excel-formatted CSV stream with UTF-8 BOM. Audits the export action.

api/admin/reset.behavior: Wipes out all participant registrations, attempts, progress, and audit logs to reset the event state for a clean run. Re-logs the reset operation.

api/admin/seed-questions.behavior: Populates the questions database with the 200 static questions from questionsData. Clears any existing questions first to prevent duplicates.

businessRules: Strict Sequential Scans: A participant must scan their assigned next_barrel_id. Random barrel hopping is blocked.

Decentralized Path Routing: In order to prevent bottlenecking at sites, each participant gets a randomized barrel path. The first barrel is chosen randomly upon registration (1 to 10), and subsequent barrels are chosen randomly from remaining unattempted ones.
Server-Side Scoring: Clients receive options shuffled and without correct answer mappings. Evaluation occurs server-side.
Server-Side Time Tracking: Duration is calculated on the server by comparing attempt start timestamps to submission timestamps, ensuring that client-side timing manipulation is prevented.
Suspended Account Guard: If is_disabled is set to true on a participant, all their active session routes (GET session, GET barrel, POST submit) return 403 Forbidden.
Rate Limiting Defaults: Enforces 5 registrations/min, 10 submissions/min, 30 scans/min, and 60 leaderboard checks/min. IP-based.
